item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:20 HKT 04/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring hot weather to the coast of southern China persistently today and tomorrow. A trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to Guangdong towards the weekend to early next week. Showers will be heavier in some areas. Under the influence of a relatively dry easterly airstream, it will be windier and bright over the coastal areas of Guangdong midweek next week.
